Citibank, N.A., a bank in New York that is part of Citigroup Inc., owns 87,900,000 shares, 42.8%, of the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, part of the US Federal Reserve System, as of 31 December 2018. Here a shareholder owns part of the central bank. At the Federal Reserve, member banks that hold a Reserve Bank's shares elect six of its nine directors; since 2010 the bankers' three Class A directors no longer vote on choosing its president.
